Section 1: Basic Computer Organisation (Questions 1 to 20)

Q1. Which component of the computer is known as the "brain" of the computer?

A) RAM B) CPU ✅ C) Hard Disk D) Monitor

Q2. What is the full form of RAM?

A) Random Access Memory ✅ B) Read Access Memory C) Random Active Memory D) Read Active Memory

Q3. Which memory is non-volatile?

A) RAM B) ROM ✅ C) Cache D) Register

Q4. What is the main difference between RAM and ROM?

A) RAM is volatile, ROM is non-volatile ✅ B) ROM is volatile, RAM is non-volatile C) Both are volatile D) Both are non-volatile

Q5. 1 Megabyte (MB) is equal to:

A) 1024 KB ✅ B) 1000 KB C) 1024 Bytes D) 1024 GB

Q6. Which of the following is the fastest memory?

A) RAM B) Hard Disk C) Cache Memory ✅ D) DVD

Q7. Which of the following is NOT a secondary storage device?

A) Hard Disk B) Pen Drive C) CD-ROM D) RAM ✅

Q8. What is the function of the Control Unit?

A) Performs calculations B) Controls and coordinates operations ✅ C) Stores data D) Displays output

Q9. 1 Gigabyte (GB) is equal to:

A) 1024 MB ✅ B) 1000 MB C) 1024 KB D) 1024 TB

Q10. Which of the following is an input device?

A) Printer B) Plotter C) Scanner ✅ D) Monitor

Q11. Which of the following is an output device?

A) Mouse B) Keyboard C) Scanner D) Printer ✅

Q12. What is the function of the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU)?

A) Controls operations B) Performs arithmetic and logical operations ✅ C) Stores data D) Manages memory

Q13. Which memory is used to store frequently accessed data for quick retrieval?

A) RAM B) Cache ✅ C) ROM D) Hard Disk

Q14. 1 Byte is equal to:

A) 4 bits B) 8 bits ✅ C) 16 bits D) 32 bits

Q15. Which of the following is a storage device?

A) Keyboard B) Mouse C) Hard Disk ✅ D) Monitor

Q16. What is the full form of CU?

A) Control Unit ✅ B) Central Unit C) Computer Unit D) Control Utility

Q17. Which type of memory is directly accessible by the CPU?

A) Secondary Memory B) Primary Memory ✅ C) Tertiary Memory D) Cache Memory

Q18. 1 Exabyte (EB) is equal to:

A) 1024 PB ✅ B) 1000 PB C) 1024 TB D) 1024 GB

Q19. What is the function of registers in CPU?

A) Store intermediate results ✅ B) Perform calculations C) Control operations D) Display output

Q20. Which of the following is a pointing device?

A) Keyboard B) Mouse ✅ C) Scanner D) Printer

Section 2: Classification of Computers (Questions 21 to 30)

Q21. Which type of computer is the most expensive?

A) Supercomputer ✅ B) Mainframe C) Mini Computer D) Personal Computer

Q22. Which type of computer is used for complex scientific calculations?

A) Mainframe B) Supercomputer ✅ C) Mini D) Micro

Q23. Which type of computer is used by large organizations for bulk data processing?

A) Supercomputer B) Mainframe Computer ✅ C) Mini Computer D) Microcomputer

Q24. Which type of computer is also called a "mid-range computer"?

A) Supercomputer B) Mainframe C) Mini Computer ✅ D) Microcomputer

Q25. Which computer is also known as a "desktop computer"?

A) Supercomputer B) Mainframe C) Mini D) Microcomputer / PC ✅

Q26. PARAM is an example of which type of computer?

A) Mainframe B) Supercomputer ✅ C) Mini D) Micro

Q27. Which type of computer is used in hospitals for patient management?

A) Supercomputer B) Mainframe C) Mini Computer ✅ D) Microcomputer

Q28. Which type of computer supports thousands of users simultaneously?

A) Supercomputer B) Mainframe Computer ✅ C) Mini D) Micro

Q29. Which computer is most suitable for personal use?

A) Supercomputer B) Mainframe C) Mini D) Microcomputer ✅

Q30. Which type of computer is used in space research?

A) Supercomputer ✅ B) Mainframe C) Mini D) Micro

Section 3: Concepts of Software (Questions 31 to 55)

Q31. Which of the following is system software?

A) Microsoft Excel B) Linux ✅ C) Adobe Photoshop D) Google Chrome

Q32. What is the role of an operating system?

A) To create documents B) To manage hardware and software resources ✅ C) To play games D) To design graphics

Q33. Which of the following is an example of application software?

A) Windows 11 B) Ubuntu C) MS PowerPoint ✅ D) BIOS

Q34. What does a compiler do?

A) Translates source code to object code ✅ B) Executes code line by line C) Loads programs into memory D) Manages files

Q35. What is the function of an interpreter?

A) Translates entire program at once B) Translates and executes program line by line ✅ C) Combines object files D) Manages memory

Q36. Which of the following is a translator?

A) Loader B) Linker C) Compiler ✅ D) Operating System

Q37. What is the function of the linker?

A) Converts source code to object code B) Links/combines object files into executable ✅ C) Loads program into memory D) Executes the program

Q38. What is the function of a loader?

A) Translates source code B) Combines object files C) Loads executable into memory ✅ D) Manages files

Q39. Which type of operating system allows only one user at a time?

A) Multi-user OS B) Single-user OS ✅ C) Multiprogramming OS D) Time-sharing OS

Q40. Which type of OS allows multiple programs to run simultaneously on a single CPU?

A) Multiprocessing B) Multiprogramming ✅ C) Single-tasking D) Real-time

Q41. What is the advantage of multiprocessing?

A) Uses multiple CPUs for faster processing ✅ B) Runs one program at a time C) Uses only one user D) Slower processing

Q42. What is time-sharing operating system?

A) CPU time is divided among multiple users ✅ B) Multiple CPUs used C) Only one user D) Batch processing

Q43. What is the full form of GUI?

A) Graphical User Interface ✅ B) General User Interface C) Graphic Utility Interface D) Graphical Unit Interface

Q44. Which of the following is a CUI operating system?

A) Windows 10 B) macOS C) Linux (with terminal) / MS-DOS ✅ D) Android

Q45. Which Linux command is used to display the current directory?

A) pwd ✅ B) cd C) ls D) dir

Q46. Which Linux command is used to copy files?

A) cp ✅ B) copy C) mv D) rm

Q47. Which Linux command is used to remove files?

A) rm ✅ B) del C) delete D) remove

Q48. Which Linux command is used to move or rename files?

A) cp B) mv ✅ C) rm D) rename

Q49. What is utility software?

A) Software that manages operating system B) Software that performs specific tasks like antivirus ✅ C) Software that creates documents D) Software that compiles programs

Q50. Which of the following is an example of utility software?

A) Windows 11 B) MS Word C) Disk Defragmenter ✅ D) Google Chrome

Q51. What is the difference between system software and application software?

A) System software runs the computer, application software helps users do tasks ✅ B) Application software runs the computer, system software helps users C) Both are the same D) System software is for games

Q52. Which of the following is a multi-user operating system?

A) Windows 10 Home B) Linux ✅ C) MS-DOS D) Windows 7 Home

Q53. Which type of OS processes transactions in real-time?

A) Batch OS B) Time-sharing OS C) Real-time OS ✅ D) Multiprogramming OS

Q54. What is the function of BIOS?

A) To boot the computer and initialize hardware ✅ B) To compile programs C) To create documents D) To manage networks

Q55. Which of the following is NOT a type of OS?

A) Batch OS B) Time-sharing OS C) Real-time OS D) Translational OS ✅

Section 4: Number System (Questions 56 to 80)

Q56. What are the digits used in the binary number system?

A) 0-9 B) 0 and 1 ✅ C) 0-7 D) 0-F

Q57. What are the digits used in the octal number system?

A) 0 and 1 B) 0-7 ✅ C) 0-9 D) 0-F

Q58. What are the digits used in the hexadecimal number system?

A) 0-7 B) 0-9 C) 0-9 and A-F ✅ D) 0-9 and A-Z

Q59. Convert binary 1101 to decimal.

A) 11 B) 12 C) 13 ✅ D) 14

Q60. Convert decimal 10 to binary.

A) 1000 B) 1010 ✅ C) 1011 D) 1100

Q61. Convert octal 15 to decimal.

A) 13 ✅ B) 15 C) 12 D) 14

Q62. Convert decimal 20 to octal.

A) 24 ✅ B) 25 C) 23 D) 22

Q63. Convert hexadecimal B to decimal.

A) 10 B) 11 ✅ C) 12 D) 13

Q64. Convert decimal 14 to hexadecimal.

A) D B) E ✅ C) F D) C

Q65. Convert binary 1011 to hexadecimal.

A) A B) B ✅ C) C D) D

Q66. What is the BCD of decimal 9?

A) 1001 ✅ B) 1010 C) 1000 D) 1111

Q67. What is the BCD of decimal 10?

A) 0001 0000 ✅ B) 1010 C) 1111 D) 0001 0001

Q68. What is the 8421 code?

A) Non-weighted code B) Weighted code (BCD) ✅ C) Grey code D) Excess-3 code

Q69. Which of the following is a non-weighted code?

A) BCD B) 8421 C) Grey Code ✅ D) Binary

Q70. What is Excess-3 code?

A) BCD + 3 ✅ B) BCD - 3 C) Binary + 3 D) Binary - 3

Q71. Convert decimal 5 to Excess-3 code.

A) 0101 B) 1000 ✅ (5 + 3 = 8 → 1000) C) 1010 D) 0110

Q72. What is ASCII code?

A) 7-bit code ✅ B) 8-bit code C) 16-bit code D) 32-bit code

Q73. How many characters can extended ASCII represent?

A) 128 B) 256 ✅ C) 512 D) 1024

Q74. What is the 2's complement of binary 1100?

A) 0011 B) 0100 ✅ (1's complement = 0011, +1 = 0100) C) 1111 D) 0000

Q75. What is the 1's complement of binary 1100?

A) 0011 ✅ B) 0100 C) 1111 D) 0000

Q76. Convert binary 11111111 to hexadecimal.

A) 255 B) FF ✅ C) F0 D) 0F

Q77. Convert octal 77 to binary.

A) 111111 ✅ (7→111, 7→111) B) 111111 C) 111111 D) 111111

Q78. Convert decimal 255 to binary.

A) 11111111 ✅ B) 10000000 C) 11110000 D) 10101010

Q79. Which is an encoding scheme for Indian languages?

A) ASCII B) ISCII ✅ C) Unicode D) EBCDIC

Q80. Which encoding scheme can represent characters from all languages?

A) ASCII B) ISCII C) Unicode ✅ D) BCD

Section 5: Boolean Algebra (Questions 81 to 100)

Q81. What is the output of 1 AND 0?

A) 0 ✅ B) 1 C) Invalid D) Depends

Q82. What is the output of 0 OR 0?

A) 0 ✅ B) 1 C) Invalid D) Depends

Q83. What is the output of 1 OR 1?

A) 0 B) 1 ✅ C) Invalid D) Depends

Q84. What is the output of NOT 0?

A) 0 B) 1 ✅ C) Invalid D) Depends

Q85. Which gate is represented by the symbol + in Boolean algebra?

A) AND B) OR ✅ C) NOT D) XOR

Q86. Which gate is represented by the symbol ' or ~?

A) AND B) OR C) NOT ✅ D) XOR

Q87. What is the truth table entry for 0 XOR 1?

A) 0 B) 1 ✅ C) Invalid D) Depends

Q88. What is the truth table entry for 1 XOR 1?

A) 0 ✅ B) 1 C) Invalid D) Depends

Q89. Which gate is also known as an inverter?

A) AND B) OR C) NOT ✅ D) NAND

Q90. Which gate is a universal gate?

A) AND B) OR C) NOR ✅ D) XOR

A) A' + B' B) A' . B' ✅ C) A . B D) A + B

Q92. According to De Morgan's theorem: (A . B)' = ?

A) A' . B' B) A' + B' ✅ C) A . B D) A + B

A) A' . B' ✅ B) A' + B' C) A . B D) A + B

A) A' . B' B) A' + B' ✅ C) A . B D) A + B

A) AND B) OR C) XOR ✅ D) XNOR

Q96. Which gate produces 1 only when inputs are same?

A) AND B) OR C) XOR D) XNOR ✅

A) A + B B) A + B' C) A' + B ✅ D) A' + B'
